name: Moccallure Professional 18-Colors Lipstick Kit | Long-Lasting, Hydrating & Compact Makeup Palette
description:
Unleash your creativity with the Moccallure Professional 18-Colors Lipstick Kit, a complete lip collection designed for bold and beautiful looks. Featuring 18 richly pigmented shades ranging from everyday nudes to statement reds, this kit offers long-lasting color, hydrating comfort, and a smooth, creamy finish. Its compact and travel-friendly design makes it the perfect addition to your beauty routine — ideal for professionals, makeup artists, and everyday users alike.Key Features:
 18 professional-quality lipstick shades in one compact palette
 Long-lasting formula for vibrant, all-day wear
 Hydrating and creamy texture ideal for dry lips
 Unisex shades suitable for all skin tones
 Lightweight, portable design perfect for travel
 Suitable for daily use and special occasionsHow to Use:
1⃣ Select your desired shade using a brush or fingertip.
2⃣ Apply evenly to clean, dry lips.
3⃣ For bolder color, layer as desired.
4⃣ Mix and match shades to create custom tones.Ingredients:
Beeswax, Vitamin E, Shea Butter, Mineral Oil, Pigments, Silica, Parfum.Safety Information:
 For external use only.
 Avoid contact with eyes.
 Store in a cool, dry place.
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs.

Package Includes:
 1 × Moccallure 18-Colors Lipstick Kit
